comment: ROUND TWO (revised, ~5 min) — 'THE KING'S BARGAIN'. Three mystery WITCHES secretly stir the board. Kane jailed (no goal). Pele (the King) makes a shock choice: he FREES caged Ronaldo, who then scores TWICE. Standings after R2: Messi 5, Haaland 4, Mbappe 4, Ronaldo 2, Kane jailed. Ends with a Round-3 viewer poll: will Neymar finally enter, or will Vinicius score again and take Brazil's place? Fantasy board = fiction; scores are OUR STORY. VO-driven sync.

lines.text: Round one is over.
But this board keeps secrets.
And tonight... the secrets have a price.
Deep beneath the board, three witches are stirring the game.
Last round, Messi was crowned, and Ronaldo was dragged into a cell.
Three kings climbed. One sat in the dark. Two rounds remained.
Now round two begins. And the dice belong to the shadows.
Because who truly rolls the dice on this board?
Not the players. Not even the King.
Three ancient witches, stirring fate in the dark.
Every goal, a spell. Every cage, a curse.
And tonight, they whisper a single name.
Harry Kane. England's captain. A nation's only hope.
Ninety minutes. Not one goal.
And the witches do not forgive an empty net.
The bars came down on the captain.
Kane joins the dark... just as another is about to leave it.
Because the Keeper has made his choice.
The hood falls, and the King of Football steps into the light.
Pele.
Three World Cups. A crown that no one could ever take.
And a decision that no one saw coming.
He walks to the cell of his greatest rival.
And he opens it.
Why would the King set Cristiano Ronaldo free?
Only the witches know. And they are smiling.
Freed from the cage, Ronaldo does not hesitate.
One strike. The net explodes.
Two. And the whole hall loses its mind.
From a prison cell to two goals in a single night.
They counted him out. They always do.
So here is the board after round two.
Messi rules with five.
Haaland, four. Mbappe, four. The chase is alive.
Ronaldo, two, and rising from the ashes.
And Kane... still behind bars.
But the witches are not finished.
They have already seen round three. And it changes everything.
A new force is coming to the board.
From Brazil. From the King's own bloodline.
But which one will it be?
Will Neymar finally answer the call, and step onto the board?
Or will Vinicius score again, and seize Brazil's crown for himself?
The King wants his heir. The witches want their price.
And only one Brazilian can enter the game.
So we ask you.
Neymar... or Vinicius?
Who enters the board in round three? Drop your prediction in the comments.
And the cup is still anyone's to take.
The board is yours now.
Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world. Pick your three legends, and change the game.
Free to play. For glory alone.
Like, share, and subscribe. Round three is coming.
